sentences.zh: 为了强调这一点，她在劳动节匹兹堡的一次集会上说了这番话。

sentences.en: U.S.

sentences.en: Steel should remain American-owned and American-operated.
sentences.zh: 钢铁公司应该保持由美国人拥有和经营。

sentences.en: So it's kind of this funny situation where all the candidates, Trump, Biden, and Harris, all agree on a policy.

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的表明了劳工和钢铁问题是如何成为这次选举中某种政治海报代言人的。

sentences.en: And so that's what set off this protracted standoff.

sentences.en: And it's really put U.S.
sentences.zh: 这确实让美国

sentences.en: Steel in a difficult situation, trying to figure out what they're going to do with this Nippon bid and figure out whether or not it's going to go forward.
sentences.zh: 钢铁公司陷入了困境，他们试图弄清楚如何处理日本制铁的收购要约，并判断这笔交易是否会继续进行。

sentences.en: So on the national stage, we're seeing the presidential candidates really compete for the steelworkers' vote, which makes sense because they need Pennsylvania to win.
sentences.zh: 所以在全国舞台上，我们看到总统候选人在争夺钢铁工人的选票，这很合理，因为他们需要宾夕法尼亚州才能获胜。

sentences.en: But at this point, he's no longer in the race.

sentences.en: So why is he doing this?

sentences.zh: 他如何为这种干预辩护？

sentences.en: So even though Biden's out of the race, he still wants Harris to win.
sentences.zh: 尽管拜登退出了竞选，但他仍然希望哈里斯获胜。

sentences.en: And he's clearly hoping to give Democrats a leg up with this move.
sentences.zh: 他显然希望通过这一举动为民主党增加筹码。

sentences.en: And so the means by which he's going to potentially block the deal has to do with this shadowy interagency panel known as CFIUS,
sentences.zh: 他可能阻止这笔交易的手段与一个名为CFIUS的神秘跨部门小组有关，

sentences.en: which is the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States.
sentences.zh: 即美国外国投资委员会。

sentences.en: Kind of a mouthful.
sentences.zh: 名字有点拗口。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It's kind of an obscure panel made up of cabinet officials across the government, and it's led by the Treasury Department.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由政府各部门内阁官员组成的鲜为人知的小组，由财政部领导。

sentences.en: It reviews foreign acquisitions of sensitive companies, infrastructure, all kinds of things that might potentially pose a threat to the United States.
sentences.zh: 它负责审查外国对敏感公司、基础设施以及任何可能对美国构成潜在威胁的事物的收购。

sentences.en: And it has the power to make recommendations to block these transactions.
sentences.zh: 它有权提出阻止这些交易的建议。

sentences.en: And Alan, what's the implication here?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，这里的含义是什么？

sentences.en: Because, of course, Japan is an important ally to the United States, specifically regarding China, which, of course, is an adversary.
sentences.zh: 因为当然，日本是美国的重要盟友，特别是在针对中国的问题上，而中国当然是对手。

sentences.en: So it's very interesting and kind of odd that a Japanese company would be seen as a security threat.
sentences.zh: 所以一家日本公司被视为安全威胁，这非常有趣，也有些奇怪。

sentences.en: Have they actually said anything about what the concerns actually are?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有说明具体的担忧是什么？

sentences.en: Not publicly.
sentences.zh: 没有公开说明。

sentences.en: The potential national security concerns that they might raise are the idea that Japan or a Japanese company getting a hold of U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们可能提出的潜在国家安全担忧是，日本或日本公司掌握美国

sentences.en: steel could potentially jeopardize, you know, the security of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 钢铁公司可能会危及，你知道，美国

sentences.en: steel sector more broadly.
sentences.zh: 钢铁行业更广泛的安全。

sentences.en: And that that's an issue if there was sort of a national emergency crisis and the United States needed steel for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 如果发生某种国家紧急危机，而美国因各种原因需要钢铁，那就会成为一个问题。

sentences.en: I think there's also been a more broadly considered view of national security and economic security and how they're defined.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于国家安全和经济安全以及它们的定义，人们也有了更广泛的考量。

sentences.en: And the idea that this could erode the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果这家公司发生什么事，可能会削弱美国

sentences.en: industrial base if something happens to this company is also something that they might say is, you know, a reason to block the deal.
sentences.zh: 工业基础，这也是他们可能提出的阻止交易的理由。

sentences.en: So what does U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么美国

sentences.en: steel say about all of this?
sentences.zh: 钢铁公司对此有何回应？

sentences.en: So they've continued to defend the logic of the deal, saying that they don't see any national security threats.
sentences.zh: 他们继续为这笔交易的逻辑辩护，称他们没有看到任何国家安全威胁。

sentences.en: This is going to be good for workers, good for workers in Pennsylvania, and that Nippon Steel really is the only option for allowing them to continue to invest in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 这对工人有好处，对宾夕法尼亚州的工人有好处，而且日本制铁确实是让他们能够继续在宾夕法尼亚州投资的唯一选择。

sentences.en: But they've also been giving some other indications that if it doesn't go through, there could be some repercussions for Pennsylvania steel workers.

sentences.en: They've suggested that there could be plant closures, layoffs, and that they might even consider relocating out of the state so they can focus on some of their plants in the south,

sentences.en: where they don't have to rely on union labor.

sentences.en: And so a lot of people in Pennsylvania see this as a threat, and they're not happy about the fact that U.S.

sentences.en: But how likely is this to happen if Nippon Steel doesn't buy this company?
sentences.zh: 但如果日本制铁不收购这家公司，这种情况发生的可能性有多大？

sentences.zh: 我认为来自不同方面，特别是日本，会有很多反弹。

sentences.zh: 我们已经听到日本的一些立法者说，美国推进并阻止这笔交易确实毫无意义，而且是不合理的。

sentences.en: Other U.S.
sentences.zh: 其他美国

sentences.en: So, Alan, is it possible that this whole move by Biden could just backfire?
sentences.zh: 那么，艾伦，拜登的这一整套举动会不会适得其反？

sentences.en: Like, in his scramble to show that he's all for American ownership and Team USA,
sentences.zh: 比如，在他急于证明自己全力支持美国所有权和“美国队”的过程中，

sentences.zh: 他最终伤害了他试图保护的工人，以及他试图赢得的摇摆州？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: There's definitely that possibility.
sentences.zh: 绝对有那种可能。

sentences.en: There's a lot of potential tradeoffs that have to be weighed here and a lot of potential reverberations that could happen depending on what he does and if the deal is blocked.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多潜在的权衡需要考量，而且根据他的做法以及交易是否被阻止，可能会产生很多潜在的连锁反应。

sentences.en: And I think that really puts the Biden administration in a difficult position where they have to weigh the possibility that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实让拜登政府处于一个困难的境地，他们必须权衡这种可能性，你知道，

sentences.en: in trying to help these workers and keep this company American-owned and in Pennsylvania, in the longer term, they may end up costing jobs in the state that they're trying to help.
sentences.zh: 在试图帮助这些工人并保持这家公司由美国人拥有并留在宾夕法尼亚州的过程中，从长远来看，他们最终可能会导致该州失去他们试图帮助的就业岗位。

sentences.en: On the other hand, I think the short-term politics are really difficult to resist and those forces are really strong.

sentences.en: The idea of giving U.S.
sentences.zh: 把美国

sentences.en: Steel away to a Japanese company and letting that happen is something that's really uncomfortable for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 钢铁公司拱手让给一家日本公司并任其发生，这对很多人来说确实令人不安。

sentences.en: And I think the potential ramifications of that and the fact that the union and labor, which is so powerful and so important, particularly in election year, is against it,
sentences.zh: 我认为其潜在的后果，以及工会和劳工——他们在选举年如此强大且重要——对此表示反对的事实，

sentences.en: is something that's really hard to avoid.
sentences.zh: 是确实难以避免的。

sentences.en: Thanks very much.

sentences.en: But mainly, the report confirmed that inflation, a key issue for voters, is continuing to cool after surging in 2021 and 2022.
sentences.zh: 但主要来说，这份报告证实了通胀——选民关注的一个关键问题——在2021年和2022年飙升后正在持续降温。

sentences.en: It's seen as the final big economic measure before the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates for the first time since early 2020,

sentences.en: Fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Dan Powell, Will Reed, and Alicia Baitu, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·李进行了事实核查，包含丹·鲍威尔、威尔·里德和艾丽西亚·拜图的原创音乐，由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方收听。
